whatThisPluginAdds.text: The Vue adapter registers a Vue client runtime with the shared Capell Inertia bridge.

surfaceOutcome.text: It adds no admin screen. Vue-based Inertia themes can use the registered entrypoint and client runtime when they render public pages.

developers.text: The provider supplies the adapter definition and assets expected by Capell Inertia, so themes do not need their own bridge wiring.

teams.text: Teams can choose a Vue Inertia theme without changing how editors manage Capell content.
